en: Low water in Germany: NRW minister warns of “aggravated situation” for inland shipping. Inland shipping on the major rivers is struggling with water levels. In view of the difficult situation, NRW Transport Minister Krischer is calling for a national crisis meeting - and a national task force to help improve the transport situation.
la: Humilis aqua in Germania: minister NRW monet de "statu aggravato" pro naviculas mediterraneas. Intus navigia in maioribus fluminibus cum aquarum gradibus laborat. Perspecta difficili condicione, minister Krischer NRW onerariam vocat discrimen nationale foederis - et vim laboris nationalis ad meliorem condicionem onerariam adiuvandam.

en: Historic low water and persistent drought: Why Germany is running out of water - and what it costs. Historical lows are being measured at several water gauges on the Rhine and Danube - with drastic consequences for nature and the economy. But the federal government remains inactive.
